/**
 * A whole file under a `__tests__` directory, skipped by its path even though
 * its name carries neither infix.
 */

export function sample(seed: number): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < seed; i += 1) {
    if (i % 3 === 0) {
      out.push(i);
    }
  }
  return out;
}
